sentences.en: I saw something unusually shiny flying in the night sky.
sentences.zh: 我看到有东西在夜空中异常地闪亮。

sentences.en: The shiny purple plums were already ripened on the tree.
sentences.zh: 树上成熟的紫色李子闪闪发光。

sentences.en: The waiting car was big and black and shiny.
sentences.zh: 等着的那辆大而黑且光亮的车。

senses.zh: 有光泽的，擦亮的；闪耀的；晴朗的
